name: Population & Quantitative Genetics
summary: The mathematics of evolution: how allele frequencies change under drift, selection, mutation and migration, and how continuous traits are inherited.

topics.name: Genetic drift, effective population size and fixation probability
Models of selection: fitness, dominance and selection coefficients
Migration, gene flow and population structure (F-statistics)
Quantitative traits: variance components and heritability
Response to selection: the breeder's equation and artificial selection
QTL mapping and the genetic architecture of complex traits
